game.name: Disney Infinity (Europe)(En,Pl,Ru,Ar)
game.desc: Disney Infinity is an action/platform game on Xbox 360 that can be played with action figures, all of which come from characters from the Disney universe, such as Jack Sparrow, the Incredibles or Bob and Sully from Monsters and Co. The Adventure mode allows us to follow a story with our character in an open world, while the ToyBox mode invites us to create a universe with the objects collected in game.
